What changes: target display · how pieces arrive in the tray · gift pieces · turning help · snap size

• Tap to turn, flip badge for PG
Suggested ages: 1 → 3–4 y · 2 → 4–5 y · 3 → 5–7 y · 4 → 7+ y. The game suggests moving up or down; grown-ups can lock a level.
